title: A Radio-to-mm Census of Star-forming Galaxies in Protocluster 4C23.56 at Z = 2.5: Gas Mass and Its Fraction Revealed with ALMA
question: What are the molecular gas masses and gas fractions of main-sequence Halpha-emitting galaxies in protocluster 4C23.56 at z=2.49, and how do they compare with field galaxies?

data.sensitivity: Band 6 ~0.08 mJy/beam; Band 3 ~0.17 mJy at 100 km/s

what.value: PHIBBS-I comparison sample (Mstar, SFR from Table 2)

evidence.quote: the values of $M_{\star}$ and SFR are simply adopted from Table 2 in (cite: Tacconi2013)

what.value: ALESS SMG 870 um fluxes and SED parameters

evidence.quote: primary beam corrected flux, column 8 in Table 3

recipe.method: CLEAN with natural weighting on calibrated visibilities
Smooth images with imsmooth, take peak flux (1.1 mm) or peak velocity-integrated flux (CO moment 0); detection criteria within 1 arcsec of HAEs
key_parameters: 1.1 mm detection >4 sigma; CO needs 2 of 3 criteria (peak >4 sigma, two channels >3.5 sigma, integrated S/N >5)

recipe.method: M_gas = alpha_CO x L'_CO with alpha_MW=4.36 times metallicity factor A(Z), R13=1.9
assumptions: metallicity from empirical mass-metallicity relation (Genzel2015 eq 12a, Wuyts2014)

recipe.goal: gas fraction, comparison and gas density
recipe.method: f_gas = Mgas/(Mgas+Mstar); compare with PHIBBS-I and ALESS main-sequence galaxies; protocluster gas density from CO detections over survey volume

evidence.quote: seven CO detections out of 22 targeted H$\alpha$ emitters (HAEs)
four out of 19 in 1.1 mm dust continuum
the cosmic gas density is estimated as $\rho_{\rm gas, 4C23.56}\sim 5 \times 10^{9} \,M_{\odot}\, {\rm Mpc}^{-3}$
in the range of $(0.5-1.4)\times 10^{11}$ M$_{\odot}$ for four objects
Pearson’s correlation coefficient (in log scale) = 0.89 with a p-value of 0.02

not_stated_but_needed: Cell size, image size, clean threshold and masks
Continuum line-free channels and continuum subtraction
Exact velocity integration ranges per source
Stellar masses and SFRs depend on unpublished Tanaka et al. analysis
Projected-density kernel details and survey volume computation
missing_for_reproduction: Mstar and SFR tables depend on in-preparation paper
Detailed imaging parameters and velocity ranges
score_reason: Public project and clear gas mass formulae, but imaging details and Mstar/SFR inputs are partly unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, formulae stated, results numeric; Mstar/SFR taken from Table 1.
